title: Enterprise Factual Synthesis & Operational Acceptance Correction

Made Organisation Overview consume the shared synthesis and added its full lineage trace to Advanced Inspection.
Separated functional human-test readiness, optional deployment metadata, and persisted-candidate regeneration impact in the operational decision owner.
expected_visible_outcomes: BT Group Organisation Overview answers what the Enterprise is from qualifying candidate facts with traceable evidence.
Industry/domain remains Not established unless independently supported; Unknowns, Contradictions and candidate governance remain unchanged.
Functional acceptance pass permits human testing despite incomplete optional deployment metadata; this read-only change requires no fresh import.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Open Import Twin and confirm functional readiness is independent of optional deployment metadata.
Open Advanced Inspection and inspect ENTERPRISE FACTUAL SYNTHESIS TRACE.
Open the Enterprise list and all six TEL-001 Enterprise dossiers.
Confirm 308 Relationships, 13 Programmes, 17 Opportunities and exact Enterprise associations remain reconciled.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required: synthesis and acceptance are read-only projections over retained candidate state.
